# Blackline 0.15.136

* The flicker is gone, and this time the cause is known rather than guessed: a repaint compared the list against its own whitespace, decided every row was out of place, and moved all of them — the conversation taken apart and put back on every change. A recorder in the running app caught hundreds of removals and insertions in a single frame. Rows are matched to what they are, dividers included; a repaint now moves nothing. Gated: 0 node moves while reactions come and go.
* A reaction on the last message scrolls the last line into view instead of leaving it half hidden.
* :shortcode: turns into its emoji as you type again, and a backslash in front keeps the words — the backslash is not part of the message.
* Editing a message to nothing and saving offers to delete it.
* The caret in the message bar is the same height beside an emoji as beside letters.
